mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60-day periods following a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS, the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite the decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% in the next month triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 20 trading days due to tightened monetary policy.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5%, or the rate does not sustain above 4.5% for the full month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals contractionary monetary policy, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases while CPIAUCSL decreases in the same period
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite the simultaneous movement of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL, or the interaction does not occur as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate over 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite UNRATE rising, or the rate does not sustain for the full 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate crossing above 6% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investor confidence declines.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite UNRATE exceeding 6%, or the crossing does not occur as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the INDPRO index signals robust production growth, boosting demand and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite INDPRO rising, or the increase does not sustain for the full month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (housing starts) signals strong economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both increase in the same period
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite both GDPC1 and HOUST rising, or the interaction does not occur as expected.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite FEDFUNDS rising, or the regime is not confirmed by other indicators (e.g., GDP growth > 2%).
